content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the trade list's scrollable rowgroup shows only a short slice of rows at a time, so users scroll down to 225 and back to 0 repeatedly, with no clicks or typing between the reversals (scroll events 276 to 310 in Scdc0bc9d, and 289 to 324 in S8b09fbb0, both after navigation app:24 or app:42 to trade list:screen).", "fix": "Fix: On the trade list:screen, change the \"Scroll container\" rowgroup so it fills the available viewport height (for example, flex: 1 with min-height: 0 on the list wrapper), and add a sticky column header inside that container so rows can be reviewed without repeated scroll-to-top returns.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:24", "app:42", "276", "282", "287", "293", "299", "305", "310", "289", "295", "301", "306", "312", "318", "324"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The window does not show what rows or data the users were looking for, so intent behind the reversals is not established.", "Whether the rowgroup's visible height is actually the cause is not verified; the page extent (\u22651055 px) comes from the insight facts, not from the events.", "Pointer samples were dropped (134 and 153), so cursor position between scrolls is incomplete.", "The windows cover only part of each session, so behaviour after the windows and the 5.7 s median loss are not verified from these events.", "No error or coverage events relate to the scroll container, so no alternative cause in the window was observed."]}
